time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Date of data investigation. Some older data from 2001. Demand of electricity updated for 2018.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average production technology.

# Included processes
Production of the cell matrix, cutting of foils and washing of glass, production of laminate and isolation. Aluminium frame of the panel. Data for direct air emissions (except NVMOC) and water emissions were not available.
